raw:
The user wants UI strings for a browser's store page in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage). They want:
- s1: store page title
- s2: install button
- s3: installed status text

Only output a JSON object with keys s1, s2, s3.

Taiwan Traditional Chinese terminology:
- Browser: 瀏覽器
- Add-ons/Extensions: In Taiwan Chrome uses 「擴充功能」, Firefox uses 「附加元件」. The user says "附加功能" but the standard Taiwan term for browser extensions is 「擴充功能」 (Chrome) or 「附加元件」 (Firefox). The prompt says "第三方做的附加功能來擴充瀏覽器" — third-party add-ons to extend the browser. Common Taiwan term: 擴充功能 or 附加元件.

s1: store page title — something like 「擴充功能商店」 or 「線上應用程式商店」. Chrome Web Store in Taiwan is 「Chrome 線上應用程式商店」. A generic one could be 「附加元件商店」 or 「擴充功能商店」. Since the page is a store for browser add-ons, maybe 「瀏覽器擴充功能商店」 or simply 「擴充功能商店」.

s2: install button — Taiwan: 「安裝」 or 「新增至瀏覽器」? Chrome uses 「加到 Chrome」. Firefox uses 「安裝」. Common: 「安裝」.

s3: installed status — 「已安裝」.

So:
{
  "s1": "擴充功能商店",
  "s2": "安裝",
  "s3": "已安裝"
}

Maybe s1 could be 「擴充功能與佈景主題」— no, keep simple. The user described "商店頁" where users install third-party add-ons. A good title: 「擴充功能商店」. Alternatively 「附加元件商店」. Either is fine; 擴充功能 is the most common Taiwan term (Chrome Taiwan).

Output only JSON.```json
{
  "s1": "擴充功能商店",
  "s2": "安裝",
  "s3": "已安裝"
}
```
